goals.title: Extract to static HTML/CSS
goals.objective: Use Stitch extract-static-html to land self-contained HTML+CSS into docs/ in the repo working tree.
goals.evidence: HTML downloaded from Stitch contribution.usercontent.google.com URL; landed at docs/index.html on the cmux-config working tree.

goals.title: Localize content + polish
goals.objective: Edit copy and links to match the locked content scope (real repo URL, exact install snippet, real overrides table, real cmux version). Verify in browser at desktop and mobile widths.
goals.evidence: Full rewrite to remove Tailwind CDN + Material Symbols + placeholder nav/URLs; replaced with vanilla CSS + inline SVGs (GitHub mark, clipboard) + real cskwork URLs. grep confirmed zero placeholders and zero marketing cliches.

goals.title: Publish + enable Pages + verify live
goals.objective: Commit docs/ to main, push, enable Pages source=main /docs via gh api, curl live URL and confirm 200 + expected strings.
goals.evidence: Pushed to cskwork/cmux-config main; Pages enabled via gh api with source=main /docs; latest build=built for commit 4f95876; live URL https://cskwork.github.io/cmux-config/ returns HTTP/2 200 with expected title and install snippet.

goals.title: Final gate
goals.objective: Run ai-slop-cleaner, rerun verification, run code-review on the diff; pass quality-gate-json with APPROVE + CLEAR.
goals.evidence: Final gate: ai-slop-cleaner passed, verification passed, code-review APPROVE+CLEAR; nits addressed in 4f95876.
